sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS NHANES public-use DEMO_J plus public-use Linked Mortality File; Human Infra DOF/sparse-domain summary boundary.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS states that subgroup degrees of freedom should be based on the number of PSUs and strata represented in the subgroup: represented PSUs minus represented strata.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The Human Infra diagnostic must evaluate represented PSU/strata coverage for every future public domain before allowing weighted-domain output.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS warns not to drop records before complex-survey procedures and recommends using software subpopulation/domain mechanisms.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The diagnostic can summarize domain DOF and sparse-domain flags, but future estimation must still use a post-design domain mechanism rather than pre-design row filtering.

sourceFindings.observedFact: NCHS data presentation standards say complex-survey proportions with fewer than 8 degrees of freedom should be flagged for statistical review.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: Human Infra treats any domain with fewer than 8 represented degrees of freedom as blocked from automatic public weighted-domain output.

sourceFindings.observedFact: NCHS data presentation standards for proportions use a minimum denominator and effective denominator sample size of 30 where applicable.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: Human Infra records the NCHS publication standard as a release-review threshold while keeping all public weighted estimates blocked until disclosure review.

sourceFindings.observedFact: A temporary public CDC/NCHS DEMO_J plus public-use LMF join can verify that all 8 sex × ageBand domains are non-empty, have no lonely represented strata, and meet the configured DOF and sparse-domain flags without persisting rows.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The DOF/sparse-domain gate can move to ready as a metadata-only public-data diagnostic, while disclosure and weighted-output implementation remain blocked.

readinessGates.evidence: Aggregate pilot validation passes and preserves aggregate-only, no-row-persistence boundaries.
Domain indicator diagnostic validation passes and still blocks weighted output.
Official NHANES variance guidance gives subgroup DOF as represented PSUs minus represented strata.
NCHS data-presentation standards flag complex-survey proportions with fewer than 8 df for statistical review.
All 8 public aggregate domains meet the configured DOF summary rule without persisting per-domain rows.
No reviewed public aggregate domain has a lonely represented stratum in the temporary calculation summary.
All reviewed public aggregate domains are non-empty and meet the configured local minimum unweighted-record policy; no counts are repeated in this diagnostic.
No public weighted domain cells, rates, intervals or subgroup summaries have passed disclosure review.
No repository artifact computes or stores public NHANES weighted domain rates or design-based intervals.

proof that public aggregate domain DOF/sparse flags can be summarized without row persistence
